decision: Reject v244 and v245 as default candidates. Keep v243-final as the strongest recorded platform reference. Do not combine the two changes on the assumption of benefit.
runtime_interpretation: Reported runtimes are well below the 1100-second product work budget and 1200-second outer limit; global deadline exhaustion is not supported. Per-request failures, incomplete outputs or quality failures cannot be excluded without logs.

local_evaluation_failure.scope: 30 previously exposed regression questions, common corpus/author; exact shared caches.
local_evaluation_failure.v244: All 30 local ties failed to reveal the 10.5-point reported platform regression. Dense fallback ran only on the absent-answer case D17, so the main recovery branch was not exercised on a factual question needing it.
local_evaluation_failure.v245: Local numeric win D07 was contradicted by its first-round written rationale. Only two edits were applied among 29 reviews; 27 reviewed drafts remained unchanged. This set did not establish the reviewer ability to repair consequential defects.
local_evaluation_failure.metric_note: The unchanged formula produced 65.2917 from one dubious win and 29 ties. Raw scores remain valid records of what the judge returned, not reliable evidence for deployment selection.
local_evaluation_failure.new_selection_rule: Use this set as a regression check only, not as a predictor of PSB score or a sole candidate-selection criterion. Future evaluation must distinguish retrieval completeness, meaningful draft correction, and judge score/rationale consistency.

hypotheses_not_confirmed: v244: a single high rerank score can keep the lexical route despite missing a complementary source or subquestion.
v245: restrictive exact patches may preserve draft omissions or wording that a full-answer reviewer would repair.
causal_limits: Separate single platform reports; hidden questions, baseline, per-question errors, settings and repeat variance are unavailable. A lower score does not establish any one mechanism as its cause.
